releaseNotes.content:
# GIB2A V26.3.6

## Display

- Refined MEDIUM NARROW dashboard geometry.
- MEDIUM NARROW applies for non-small layouts from 460 px inclusive to below 600 px.
- Increased RPM/EGT gauge size.
- Adjusted PUMP gauge size.
- RPM/EGT numeric values moved 2 px downward in this layout.
- Automatic gauge-value font fitting remains enabled.
- Narrow side panels are enabled according to available vertical clearance using the 121 px threshold.
- FULL 800x480 geometry remains unchanged.

## Widget identification

- Corrected the registered ETHOS widget title from "Widjet" to "Widget".
- Registered title is now: GIB2A TURBINE Widget V26.3.6.
